entries.task: Session 1 writes docs/planning/solution-plan.md from docs/planning/brief.md and nothing else: one paragraph on the repository as found -- an ASP.NET MVC 5 store on .NET Framework 4.5.1, four non-SDK projects in Store.sln at the root (Store.Model, Store.Data, Store.Service, Store.Web) restoring from packages.config, built by the compile control's MSBuild, and no tests or test suite -- and one section per change: the calculator page (CalculatorService in Store.Service, CalculatorController and Views/Calculator/Index.cshtml in Store.Web, a navigation link, every new file listed in its .csproj, and the repository's first tests, a non-SDK MSTest project Store.Service.Tests at v4.5.1 in Store.sln with MSTest's framework and adapter from packages.config, run by vstest, whose suite the same session declares in dabbler.yaml) and the documentation comments on what it added.
